_note: Twenty questions about CDM2/toveli at commit 0abafdc. Every answer key was checked against the code on 2026-11-15, before the mapper was written. An agent must end with one line 'ANSWER: ...'. For type 'set' the line is a comma-separated list and must equal the key as a set. For type 'facts' every group must match the ANSWER line (case-insensitive regular expressions; any alternative in a group counts). The ANSWER line is cut at 400 characters before grading, so dumping text does not help.

questions.question: Which package manager and exact version does this repository pin, and in which file is the pin?
What Node.js version does the committed .nvmrc pin, and what range does the root package.json engines field allow?
Which root script runs the full local check, and which three scripts does it chain?
Name the two GitHub Actions workflow files and the job name each one defines.
How does the root command `pnpm db:migrate` reach the code that applies migrations? Name the workspace package, the tool that runs the script, and the source file.
Does the repository contain a production deployment workflow, or a Dockerfile that builds the API image? Start the answer with yes or no and name the only Dockerfile that exists.
Which workspace packages does apps/api depend on? Answer with the short package names.
Which workspace packages does packages/db depend on? Answer with the short package names.
Which workspaces (apps and packages) depend on no other workspace package? Answer with the short names.
If @toveli/domain changes, which workspaces depend on it directly or through another workspace package? Answer with the short names.
Which ORM does packages/db use, at which exact version, and which file configures its migration generator?
What is the API server's entry file, and which exported function, in which file, builds the Fastify app?
Which file does the mobile app's package.json name as its entry, and which function call in it registers the root component?
What is packages/db/src/test-db-guard.ts for?
Which file defines the OTP rate limits for the auth routes, and what is the limit on OTP requests per email address, over what window?
Which migration file creates the core record tables, and how many CREATE TABLE statements does it contain?
In the worker's job runner, what happens to a job's handler when the capability gate denies the job?
What HTTP status does the API's gate plugin send when the gate decision is client_blocked?
In the API configuration, what are the default PORT and HOST when the environment sets neither?
Which two values may AUTH_PROVIDER take, and which two environment variables become required when it is set to supabase?
